collections.notes: Gorgias was hostile to the usual scrape: all docs.gorgias.com seed articles render their body from embedded JSON (__NEXT_DATA__ htmlContent) that contains ZERO inline images in the current article versions — the handover, guidance, setup, and how-it-works docs describe the UI but ship no screenshots (verified by parsing the JSON). The ai-agent-guardrails blog post's own body has no product UI either (hero art only; the old screenshots in its HTML belong to a shared related-content module of 2022-era SMS posts). The real yield came from updates.gorgias.com (the Noticeable changelog, images on storage.noticeable.io) and the 'Our AI Approach' blog post, whose avif screenshots I converted to png with sips. Could NOT get: an SLA-badge shot or a current-brand home-queue/ticket-list screenshot (marketing pages now use video/Lottie; the only queue image found was a 2022-era stylized render with greeked sidebar text, which I discarded), and the 'new AI & Automation analytics' update post embeds a Loom video instead of images. Caveat: gorgias-01, -02, and -04 are Gorgias' own polished changelog renders of the real UI (legible interface detail); gorgias-03, -05, -06, -07, -08 are raw product screenshots. gorgias-06 came from the same page as -05 but shows the distinct 'pick the resource the AI should have used' correction flow.
